scripts.mcp:example: jq '.mcpServers |= with_entries((.value.env // {}) as $env | .value.env = ($env | with_entries(if .key == "SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN" then .value = "YOUR_SUPABASE_PAT" elif .key == "RAILWAY_API_TOKEN" then .value = "YOUR_RAILWAY_ACCOUNT_TOKEN" elif .key == "RAILWAY_TOKEN" then .value = "YOUR_RAILWAY_PROJECT_TOKEN" elif .key == "SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" then . else .value = ("YOUR_" + .key) end)) | if .value.args then .value.args |= map(sub("^/Users/[^/]+/"; "/Users/YOUR_USER/")) else . end)' .cursor/mcp.json > .cursor/mcp.json.example
